memory_update.text: AXTI should remain the primary US-listed direct InP substrate candidate for this node, but export-license timing and China production concentration are both upside bottleneck and downside risk.

VECO is a strong Layer 1B underfollowed equipment candidate because it has disclosed more than $250 million of InP laser manufacturing equipment orders tied to silicon photonics and hyperscale datacenter transceiver demand.

ASYS belongs in speculative_shadow only until direct InP photonics customer evidence is found; the current case rests on substrate polishing, CMP, cleaning, optics/photonics, and InP process-chemical adjacency.

COHR is useful as a reference anchor for InP laser capacity constraints and 6-inch InP ramp validation, but it should not dominate the underfollowed lane because attention and market cap are already high.

Need a focused follow-up on non-US or ADR-accessible InP substrate and epitaxy names such as Sumitomo Electric, JX Advanced Metals, IQE, Taiwan compound-semiconductor foundries, and private/public Asian silicon-photonics suppliers; excluded here because this pass requested US-listed companies.

node: Indium phosphide wafers and optical substrates for AI networking
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the InP optical-substrate chokepoint found one direct substrate producer, one direct compound-semiconductor tool supplier, one speculative substrate-processing equipment/consumables supplier, and one downstream reference anchor. The highest-node-purity US-listed candidate is AXTI because its InP substrate revenue is directly tied to China export permits and AI infrastructure demand. VECO is a stronger underfollowed equipment-vendor candidate after announcing more than $250 million of orders for tools used in InP laser manufacturing. ASYS is a small-cap speculative-shadow candidate: it sells lapping, polishing, cleaning, CMP, and photonics/compound-substrate consumables, but specific InP AI-optics customer exposure still needs verification. COHR is included as a reference anchor because it validates demand for InP lasers and 6-inch InP capacity, but it is now a high-attention large-cap rather than the main discovery target.
